title: UI: workspace delete confirmation as a compact popup like session delete (not an inline list block)
outcome: UI: workspace delete confirmation as a compact popup like session delete (not an inline list block)
acceptance: Deleting a workspace shows a compact confirmation popup anchored at that workspace's entry, reusing the existing session-delete confirmation pattern, instead of the inline 'Delete <id>? This removes the saved layout.' block that pushes the list. The popup states clearly what is removed: the saved layout only, not files.

It has Confirm delete and Cancel. Focus moves into the popup on open and returns to the triggering entry on cancel (or to a sensible neighbour after delete). Escape cancels, keyboard activation works, and the popup stays fully visible for the first and last entries of the list.

Behavioral Vitest coverage for open, cancel, confirm, focus return and edge placement. `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean. The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
